risks.risk: Actual wattage/rating of the panels is unknown, which is the single biggest driver of price for solar panels.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the manufacturer's rating label/sticker on the back of each panel showing wattage, voltage, and model.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this, since price range for 'a solar panel' spans too widely by wattage

risks.risk: Working condition/output is unverified; panel could be cracked internally, delaminated, or producing reduced output.
risks.proof: Photo/video of a multimeter or clamp meter connected to the panel in sunlight showing voltage/current output.

risks.risk: Physical condition of glass and frame on the hidden/far side of panels not shown.
risks.proof: Additional photos from multiple angles including the back of each panel and close-ups of corners/edges.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming visible-side-only condition, worst case for unseen side (possible cracks/dents).

risks.risk: Age and prior usage/exposure (sun-weathering, hail damage) unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of original purchase receipt or installation date, or visible manufacture date on label.
